plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Mechanical-Electrical Technology Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 25, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7587/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each major course). Official Total Units: 49; this seed models the map path = 1+12+12+12+12 = 49 units. Term sums verified against the map's Other Term (1) / 12 / 12 / 12 / 12 headers. HVAC 250 (Other Term) is offered prior to the start of the term; refer to the class schedule and speak with a counselor. The MET-prefixed prerequisites are the parallel Mechanical Technology courses; they are listed in external_prereqs (real courses not sequenced in this HVAC-track map). Sequencing prereqs per map: HVAC 256, 257, 351 require HVAC 250; HVAC 352, 357 require HVAC 250 and MET 250; HVAC 360 requires HVAC 256, 257, 351, 357, MET 256, 257, 351, 357; HVAC 361 requires HVAC 351; HVAC 362 requires HVAC 351 and 352; HVAC 363 requires HVAC 351 or MET 351; HVAC 364 requires HVAC 256, 351, 352, 357, MET 256, 351, 352, 357; HVAC 371 requires HVAC 351, MET 360, MET 364; HVAC 372 requires HVAC 361 and 362; HVAC 373 requires HVAC 361, MET 360, MET 364; HVAC 374 requires HVAC 361, MET 361, MET 364; HVAC 381 requires HVAC 371 and 372; HVAC 383 requires HVAC 371, 372, 373, 374; HVAC 384 requires HVAC 371, 374, MET 371, MET 374; HVAC 388 requires HVAC 371, 372, 373, MET 371, 372, 373. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
